entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Ambika Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arpit Kumar, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.37
of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 471, 468 and 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Naka
Hindola, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 01.03.2023 against one Jitendra Kumar, alleging that the accused is related to the informant and he had offered to get the persons employed in government service upon payment of money.
It is alleged that the informant himself paid money to the applicant and he made some other persons also pay money to him for securing employment.
The F.I.R. has been lodged when the informant failed to secure the employment or get refund of his money.

4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. he stated that the applicant is related to his wife and he was also involved with the named accused person Jitendra Kumar in taking money.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
The named co-accused Jitendra Kumar has already been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 18.10.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12402 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12402 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Another co-accused Shiv Kumari has also been granted anticipatory bail by this court by means of an order dated 10.10.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.2212 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.2212 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 17.08.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
